আমি কি কাস্টম ডিজাইন অর্ডার করতে পারব?

knowledgeBase.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
knowledgeBase.content:
Our delivery partners are Steadfast Delivery and Pathao Courier.
      
      - Inside Dhaka: 60 BDT (24 to 48 hours delivery). Same-day delivery is available upon special request at 150 BDT (orders must be placed before 11:00 AM).
      - Outside Dhaka: 120 BDT (3 to 5 business days delivery).
      - We offer Cash on Delivery (COD) nationwide, which means you pay only when you receive your package.
      - Please inspect the product in front of the delivery agent. If there is a sizing issue or damage, return it immediately to the delivery agent.

knowledgeBase.title: Return & Exchange Policy
knowledgeBase.content:
We accept returns and exchanges within 7 days of delivery:
      
      - The item must be unused, unwashed, and have all original tags intact.
      - To process an exchange, contact us on our WhatsApp or Page inbox, and share your Order ID and the preferred size.
      - For size exchanges, the customer bears the return delivery cost (120 BDT outside Dhaka, 60 BDT inside Dhaka) unless the issue was due to our mistake.
      - Refund requests are processed within 3-5 business days via bKash, Rocket, or Bank Transfer once we receive and inspect the returned item.

knowledgeBase.title: Size Selection Guide
knowledgeBase.content:
We manufacture clothing according to standard Bangladeshi/Subcontinent sizing charts:
      
      - Panjabi Sizes: 
        * Size 38: Chest 39 inches, Length 40 inches
        * Size 40: Chest 41 inches, Length 42 inches
        * Size 42: Chest 43 inches, Length 44 inches
        * Size 44: Chest 45 inches, Length 46 inches
        
      - Women's Kurti Sizes:
        * Size S (36): Chest 36 inches, Length 38 inches
        * Size M (38): Chest 38 inches, Length 40 inches
        * Size L (40): Chest 40 inches, Length 42 inches
        * Size XL (42): Chest 42 inches, Length 44 inches
        * Size XXL (44): Chest 44 inches, Length 44 inches

faqs.question: Do you offer cash on delivery (COD)?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer cash on delivery nationwide in Bangladesh. You pay only after receiving and verifying the product package.

faqs.question: How do I choose my clothing size?
faqs.answer: Please consult our Size Selection Guide in the Knowledge Base. Panjabis are sized 38, 40, 42, 44 based on shoulder/chest. Kurtis are sized 36, 38, 40, 42, 44 based on bust circumference. Let us know your height and chest measurements and our AI can suggest the best fit!

faqs.question: Where is your retail boutique outlet located?
faqs.answer: Our flagship outlet is located at: House 12, Road 5, Dhanmondi, Dhaka 1205 (Opposite Dhanmondi Lake). We are open daily from 10:00 AM to 8:30 PM.

faqs.question: ডেলিভারি চার্জ কত এবং কতদিন সময় লাগে?
faqs.answer: ঢাকা সিটির ভেতরে ডেলিভারি চার্জ ৬০ টাকা (১-২ দিন সময় লাগে)। ঢাকা সিটির বাইরে ডেলিভারি চার্জ ১২০ টাকা (৩-৫ দিন সময় লাগে)। আমাদের ইমার্জেন্সি একই দিনের ডেলিভারি চার্জ ১৫০ টাকা (দুপুর ১২টার আগে অর্ডার করতে হবে)।
